name: Incremental Pattern Matching Benchmark for Graph Transformation
description: A benchmark evaluation suite measuring performance and correctness of incremental pattern matching algorithms within graph transformation systems.
evaluation_method: execution_time / memory footprint / correctness rate (match accuracy)
reputation: A well-cited, niche benchmark in the graph-transformation research community for evaluating incremental pattern-matching algorithms.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on algorithmic performance; often uses synthetic or small graph workloads; not directly applicable to language models.
